senses.gloss_en: savage; brutally witty

senses.gloss_en: aloe; aloe vera

senses.gloss_en: logarithm

senses.gloss_en: disorderly; sloppy; incoherent

examples.vi: Nó nói lôm côm, tôi nghe chẳng hiểu gì cả.

examples.en: He scammed hundreds of people with promises of high returns.

senses.gloss_en: quietly and with head down, without a word

examples.vi: Anh ấy lùi lũi đi về một mình.
examples.en: He quietly walked home alone, head down.

senses.gloss_en: confused; muddle-headed (forgetful, especially from old age)

examples.vi: Ông tôi già rồi nên hay lú lẫn.

senses.gloss_en: sorghum

examples.en: People grow sorghum as feed for livestock.

senses.gloss_en: wet rice; paddy rice

examples.en: The car rocks from side to side on the bad road.

senses.gloss_en: to swing from side to side; to shake

examples.vi: Cô bé lúc lắc cái đầu theo điệu nhạc.
examples.en: The little girl swings her head from side to side to the music.

senses.gloss_en: hanging down heavily (of fruit, etc.)

examples.vi: Lúc ấy tôi đang ở nhà bà ngoại.
examples.en: At that time I was at my grandmother's house.

senses.gloss_en: bent over and busy with a task; absorbed in one's work

examples.vi: Mẹ đang lúi húi nấu cơm trong bếp.
